sentences.en: Y is pronounced with the tongue approximating the hard palate.
sentences.zh: 舌头靠近硬腭发音的是Y。

sentences.en: This will give you an approximate idea of the situation.
sentences.zh: 这将给你一个大致的情况了解。

sentences.en: My annual income approximates fifteen million yen, I suppose.
sentences.zh: 我的年收入大约是1500万日元，大概是这样。
